intro.en: The vocabulary of history books: reigns, wars, treaties and the centuries, with a short look at Spain's own past.

texto.en:
**Time.** **El siglo** is written in Roman numerals and read as a cardinal number: **el siglo XV** is el siglo quince. **A principios de**, **a mediados de**, **a finales de** siglo. **La época**, **la era**, **la Edad Media**, **la Edad Moderna**. **Antes de Cristo** (a. C.) and **después de Cristo** (d. C.).

**Power.** **Un rey** has **un reinado**; **un emperador**, **un imperio**. **Gobernar**, **reinar**, **heredar el trono**, **abdicar**.

**War.** **Estalla** una guerra. **El ejército** **invade** un país, **lucha en** una batalla, **vence a** su enemigo or sufre **una derrota**. The loser **se rinde**. Countries on the same side are **aliados**. At the end, they **firman un tratado de paz**.

**The tenses of history.** The indefinido tells the events: **estalló**, **duró**, **murió**. The imperfect describes the background: **era**, **había**, **vivían**. The historical present makes them vivid: en 1492 Colón **llega** a América. And the passive is common: **fue conquistada**, **fue firmado**.

**Spain in one paragraph.** The Romans called it Hispania. From 711 much of the peninsula was Muslim **al-Ándalus**, for almost eight centuries. In 1492 the Catholic Monarchs took Granada and Columbus reached America. **La Guerra Civil** lasted from 1936 to 1939 and was followed by **la dictadura** of Franco, who died in 1975. Then came **la Transición** to democracy and the Constitution of 1978.

frases.es: La Guerra Civil española estalló en julio de 1936, cuando una parte del ejército se levantó contra el gobierno de la República.
frases.en: The Spanish Civil War broke out in July 1936, when part of the army rebelled against the government of the Republic.

frases.es: Lo que algunos sublevados esperaban resolver en unos días duró casi tres años y dividió a familias enteras.
frases.en: What some rebels expected to resolve in a few days lasted almost three years and divided entire families.

frases.es: Los dos bandos recibieron apoyo extranjero, y el conflicto suele estudiarse también en relación con las tensiones que desembocaron en la Segunda Guerra Mundial.
frases.en: Both sides received foreign support, and the conflict is also studied in relation to the tensions that led to the Second World War.

frases.es: La República fue derrotada en abril de 1939; cientos de miles de personas cruzaron la frontera hacia el exilio.
frases.en: The Republic was defeated in April 1939; hundreds of thousands of people crossed the border into exile.

frases.es: Siguió una dictadura que terminó con la muerte de Franco, en 1975.
frases.en: A dictatorship followed and ended with Franco dying in 1975.

frases.es: Durante la Transición se aprobaron medidas de amnistía y se priorizó la reconciliación política, pero sus efectos y sus límites siguen siendo objeto de debate.
frases.en: During the transition, amnesty measures were passed and political reconciliation was prioritised, but their effects and limits remain debated.

frases.es: Casi un siglo después, la guerra continúa presente en la política, la literatura y la memoria de muchas familias.
frases.en: Almost a century later, the war remains present in politics, literature and the memory of many families.

pregunta.en: According to the text, how long did the war last?

A few days.en: That is what the military expected.

Forty years.en: That is roughly how long the war and the dictatorship lasted together.

pregunta.en: What does the text say about political reconciliation during the Transition?

Amnesty measures were passed, and reconc.en: The article also notes that the limits and effects remain debated.

bloques.correcta: Amnesty measures were passed, and reconciliation was prioritised; their effects remain debated

el siglo dieciocho.en: Centuries are read as cardinal numbers.

el siglo decimoctavo.en: Ordinals are only usual up to ten.

traduccion.en: In the middle of the twentieth century the war ended.
